sources.excerpt: Fuzz Smooth, liquid fuzz-distortion built for soaring solos and endless sustain. The Starlight combines JFET and MOSFET gain stages for a smooth, liquid fuzz-distortion voiced for lead playing. A huge gain range delivers everything from low-gain edgy breakup to thick, soaring fuzz with fat mids and creamy highs, all with a natural sagging compression that provides sustain and feedback without losing note definition. Three knobs cover the essentials: Gain sets the drive amount, Tone shapes the frequency response, and Volume controls output level. A toggle switch adds extra gain and high-mid presence for almost endless harmonics when you need to push into more aggressive territory. Hand-built in Greece, the Starlight has earned a loyal following among working players including Pete Thorn and James Valentine of Maroon 5.
